stories.title: Trump believes Democrats will impeach him if they win congressional elections
stories.summary: WASHINGTON, August 22. US President Donald Trump believes Democrats will impeach him if Republicans lose the midterm congressional elections in November. "I'm going to be impeached. They're going to impeach me. They have no idea why," Trump told supporters in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina. Trump is the first president in US history to face two impeachment proceedings. Both cases occurred during his first presidential term, in 2019 and 2021, and were ultimately blocked by the Senate.

stories.title: Larry the Cat dismisses death rumors with iconic Mark Twain quote
stories.summary: LONDON, August 22. Larry the Cat, the resident of the British Prime Minister's official home, has dismissed rumors of his death by using a famous line penned by American writer Mark Twain. "Reports of my death have been greatly exaggerated..." a post reads on the chief mouser's official X account. Earlier, the Politics UK account on X posted a message claiming that Larry had passed away. The post was later deleted, with the account clarifying that the information was false and had originated from a previously compromised source. Larry the Cat has resided at Downing Street since 2011, outlasting six British prime ministers: David Cameron, Theresa May, Boris Johnson, Liz Truss, Rishi Sunak, and Keir Starmer. Adopted from a shelter, he holds the official title of Chief Mouser to the Cabinet Office. Larry's X page regularly features sarcastic commentary targeting British politicians.
